issue.title: Keep the header sync icon in step with pending and failed uploads [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios A.1, A.2, B.3, B.8)

## Summary

The header sync icon is stale and differs between screens, and offline with nothing pending it uses the wrong glyph.

Home, the chapter screen, ViewProject and Sync each run their own `useSyncStatus` / `usePendingUploads` instance with no shared store. The pending state reloads only on upload events or a `refreshKey` bump (`src/hooks/usePendingUploads.ts:99-148`), not on focus or when a take is recorded or deleted. Offline with nothing pending, the header draws `CloudOff` (`src/components/ui/CloudSyncStatusIcon.tsx:297-303`), while #38 and the Sync page use gray `cloud-check`.

## Expected

Every header shows the same, current sync state (#38).

## Actual

- Offline, after recording a take, Home keeps the struck-out cloud without an arrow while the chapter screen and Sync show the pending variant; Home updates only after an app restart, also after deleting the take.
- After all uploads finished, My Work still showed pending.
- After deleting a failed take, Sync showed a green check, Home the red failed arrow, and the chapter screen green.
- Offline with nothing pending, the header shows `CloudOff`, not gray `cloud-check`.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Offline, record a take, go back to Home; then delete the take.
2. Online, let uploads finish on Sync and go back to My Work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One shared sync-status source feeds every header and the Sync page.
- [ ] It refreshes when a take is saved or deleted, when uploads change state, and on focus.
- [ ] Offline glyphs match #38 (confirm the offline-synced glyph with product).
- [ ] Unit tests for the shared source and its refresh triggers.
- [ ] Android device QA (A.1, A.2, B.3, B.8).

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #38, #101
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)

comments.body: Note for the offline header glyph: the going offline audit (#529, scenario G.22) recorded the offline header as gray `cloud-check` (Pass), but the header draws `CloudOff` for `offline_synced` on `main` (`src/components/ui/CloudSyncStatusIcon.tsx:297-303`, not changed by PR #559). #529 most likely read the Sync page glyph. The returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, scenario A.2) has the correct result, and it is tracked here. The expected glyph (#38: gray `cloud-check`) still needs product confirmation (#530 Open Questions).

**Test Results – Sync Status Icon** 1. The sync status icon is displayed in the top-right navigation bar. 2. The icon changes correctly based on the current connectivity and sync status. 3. The online synced state displays a cloud with a green checkmark. 4. The online syncing state displays a cloud with green refresh arrows. 5. The online pending upload state displays a cloud with a yellow upload arrow. 6. The offline synced and offline pending upload states display their respective icons in gray. 7. The icon correctly reflects server connectivity, even when the device has a network connection but the Fluent server is unreachable. 8. Tapping the sync status icon navigates to the Sync page. **Issue IDentified:** Sync is not working in Pericope view, and is displayed as “Missing Bible Text ID.”
I can confirm that when in pericope mode, that error message displays when I got to the Sync page. @B3RN153 take a look.
